result:
I've finished and confirmed the interrupted T-DG5-KBE-C2 work, and every acceptance check passes on the final tree.

**What I found.** Every file the handback lists exists and is complete, and the code matches what the handback says. The work for §F.2 was all there, so I made no source change. Two things were not finished:
- The handback still had three placeholders: the end time, the checks section (§3) and the "what remains" section (§9).
- The interrupted run's logs were not valid evidence for the final tree:
  - `business-cases.ts` changed at 22:31Z, after the typecheck, build, lint, Prettier and OpenAPI runs.
  - Its last unit-test log was cut off by the restart. It shows an `architecture.test.ts` timeout under load.
  - An earlier unit run also failed under load: the same timeout, plus one `raid.test.tsx` failure.
  - Neither of those test files is mine, and neither failure came back in my runs.

**Checks re-run on the final tree**, one after another so they didn't slow each other down. All exited 0:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG4` | `PASS gate DG4 (historical)` at the start and at the end |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm openapi:lint` | all passed (OpenAPI: 846 operations) |
| Prettier check over all files | all files formatted; re-run after the handback was final |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset | 106 files / 1894 tests; 72 files / 1400 tests; 259 tests passed + 2 skipped of 261 |
| `pnpm test`, `C.UTF-8` | the same counts |
| Integration tests with PostgreSQL on ports 23950 / 23951–23999 | 230 files / 2232 tests passed; no pinned-count change |

The 2 skipped tests were already skipped before this work. My own tests pass: 9 unit tests and 8 integration tests.

**Handback.** `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-KBE-C2-kpi-benefits-engineer.md` now starts with a "Continuation run (T-DG5-KBE-C2B)" section naming the interrupted run and listing what I found, finished and re-ran. I filled in the three missing sections and corrected the parts that were no longer true: the base and commit state, the old end time, and the failure history. The new logs are in `T-DG5-KBE-C2-evidence/`, each with a `-B` suffix; the old logs are kept unchanged for provenance.

**Still open:**
- REQ-S13-004 and REQ-S13-008 only complete once the later tasks (KBE-D2, BE-M/BE-N and FE-E) are done.
- Two optional requests for you, neither blocking:
  - Let a gate pack show live criterion results for a gate that hasn't been submitted yet. Today it shows every criterion as Unknown.
  - Export the roadmap schedule flags so the roadmap report can show them.

No migration, schema, OpenAPI or dependency change was needed, and I found no user-facing text that this work made untrue. The `-B` logs and the handback edit are uncommitted, on top of WIP commit `4459ddf`, ready for you to merge.
